title: Occam selection between builders (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/selection.json, N=2)
description: Written by a2dlc run at the end of Stage 4 when there were two candidates. Each was judged with the other as peer (veredicto_primary.json, veredicto_orthogonal.json). Among those that gave PASS, the one with lower complexity wins, lexicographic: sum of cyclomatic, then sum of ast_nodes, then loc_added + loc_removed; a metric missing from either one is not compared, and the final tie goes to builder_primary. With a single PASS, that one, without measuring complexity. With no PASS, selected is null and the run's outcome is the worse of the two verdicts (FAIL before INCONCLUSIVE). If both fail a test that the other passes, CB-01: selected null and the stage escalates.

complexity.description: null if it was not measured (not needed, or the verdict is not PASS). Totals over the measured files; unmeasured are the changed files that no engine measured (no engine, or an engine without operation: complexity).
